addresses.name: transfer_src_overlay
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: VramTransferManager.c overlay transfer routine; calls GraphicSystemCoreFinish_helper (0xFC143493 at 0xFC380670) and MakeOsdVram (0xFC183A13 at 0xFC3806F2) to compose Canon RGBA source window (0x41D81000) into bitmap_buffer[idx] and opacity_buffer[idx].

addresses.name: GraphicSystemCoreFinish_helper
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: Calls GraphicSystemCoreFinish (0xFC20C5BF) and then reads RAM callback pointer *(0x0000E26C) at 0xFC14349A and invokes it via blx r0 at 0xFC1434A0 if non-zero.

addresses.name: GraphicSystemCoreFinish_callback_ptr
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: RAM function pointer read by GraphicSystemCoreFinish_helper (0xFC143493 at 0xFC14349A) and setter sub_fc143480 (0xFC143481). Chosen RAM function-pointer hook point.

addresses.name: GraphicSystemCoreFinish
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: Sends synchronous Zico GraphicSystemCoreFinish message via mzrm_createmsg (0xFC332539) and mzrm_sendmsg (0xFC33262D).

addresses.name: MakeOsdVram
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: MakeOsdVram.c wrapper calling sub_fc183824 (0xFC183825) -> sub_fc20c6d0 (0xFC20C6D1) -> mzrm_sendmsg (0xFC33262D) to synchronously DMA-compose source RGBA window (0x41D81000) into target bitmap_buffer[idx] and opacity_buffer[idx].

addresses.name: VTM_FlipAndCommit
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: Runtime writer of active_bitmap_buffer (0x0000D2A4): executes str r0, [r5, #64] at 0xFC38091E (where r5 = 0x0000D264) and commits the buffer via BmpDDev_SetBitmapVRAMAddress (0xFC183690 at 0xFC38092E/0xFC38093E).

addresses.name: VTM_SelectNextBuffer
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: Computes next_bitmap_buffer = 1 - active_bitmap_buffer (rsb r0, r0, #1 at 0xFC38099A) and stores it at 0x0000D2A0 ([r5, #60] at 0xFC38099E) and in display descriptor [r4, #4] (0xFC3809A4).

addresses.name: VTMUnLock_flush
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: Core VramTransferManager flush sequence: redraws dirty windows via *(0x0000D28C), calls GraphicSystemCoreFinish_helper (0xFC143493 at 0xFC3809DA), selects inactive buffer via 0xFC380985 (at 0xFC380A12), overwrites inactive buffer via 0xFC3806FD -> transfer_src_overlay (at 0xFC380A16), and flips active_bitmap_buffer + commits display via 0xFC38090B (at 0xFC380A1C).

addresses.name: VTMLock
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: Acquires VTM semaphore and increments VTM lock nesting counter at 0x0000D294.

addresses.name: VTMUnLock
addresses.label: ROM_VERIFIED
addresses.description: Decrements VTM lock nesting counter at 0x0000D294 and triggers VTMUnLock_flush (0xFC3809AF) when lock count reaches zero.

addresses.name: ScreenLock
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: Acquires VTM mutex and delegates to VTMLock_inner (0xFC380865).

addresses.name: ScreenUnlock
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: Acquires VTM mutex and delegates to VTMUnLock_inner (0xFC380A79 -> 0xFC3809AF).

addresses.name: transfer_src_overlay_helper
addresses.label: FINSIG
addresses.description: Emergency/direct VTM transfer helper calling transfer_src_overlay (0xFC380635 at 0xFC381174) and BmpDDev_SetBitmapVRAMAddress (0xFC183690 at 0xFC38117E).

addresses.name: BmpDDev_SetBitmapVRAMAddress

addresses.description: Commits bitmap_buffer[idx] and opacity_buffer[idx] to display controller via DispCon_SetBitmapPlane (0xFC14255C), DispCon_SetOpacityPlane (0xFC14268C), and DispCon_LatchRegisters (0xFC1424AC).
